# getNoteCategory — GET /notes/categories/{noteCategoryId}

Get a note category

## Verified behaviors

- **An unknown category 404s with the envelope; a non-int32 id gets HTML** — Only ids in the int32 range route to the handler, which answers the standard 404 envelope for a category that does not exist. An id above 2147483647 matches no route at all and gets IIS's HTML 404 page instead — a different content type, not just a different body. ([replay](../behaviors/note-category-404s-come-in-two-shapes.md))

## Behavior

Returns a single note category as a bare object, in the same shape as the items of `GET /notes/categories`.

Unlike the list endpoint, this one is not filtered by the committee opt-in: it addresses a category by id directly. The sandbox committee has no categories at all, so every id probed answered 404 and the populated shape has still not been observed live.

Only ids in the int32 range route here. An id of `0` or a negative id reaches the handler and 500s; anything above 2147483647 or non-numeric matches no route and gets an IIS HTML 404.

## Example

```bash
curl -sS -X GET \
  'https://api.securevan.com/v4/notes/categories/10' \
  -u "app-name:$NGP_API_KEY|1"
```

### `200` body — NoteCategory

A note category available in the current context.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `noteCategoryId` | integer | Unique identifier of the category — the value to send as `category.noteCategoryId` when writing a note. e.g. `24` |
| `name` | string or null | Display name of the category. e.g. `Event Details` |
| `assignableTypes` | array of string or null | The note category types this category can be applied to — the entities a note in it can hang off. Values are drawn from `GET /notes/categoryTypes`, which in almost all contexts is `Event`, `Location`, `Person` and `Organization`. A category can only be used on a person note if this array contains `Person`; sending the id of any other category to `POST /people/{vanId}/notes` returns 400. e.g. `['Event', 'Organization']` |

`*` = required.
